# fastspec

> Dynamic OpenAPI, Discovery, and GraphQL spec client for Python — turn any API spec into a fully-typed async client with attribute chaining, streaming, and file uploads

## Modules

- [fastspec.gql](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fastspec/gql.html.md): Build GraphQL queries by field-checked attribute chaining, reuse distilled schemas, and combine queries into batched requests
